svg.aria-label: Sales Inventory CRM: Sales, stock and win-back of lost customers for shops with several branches. A two-process race test checks the last unit sells only once. How it works: a React point of sale calls a Laravel API, which locks stock rows in MySQL and queues follow-up work in Redis.
